selection_rule: Select all, odd-indexed or no elements in each enabled native domain. Then apply the native selection flush and capture the actual initial state.
history_rule: Use no history, selected native components in creation order, or that order reversed. Do not synthesize an active component when the selected set is empty.
initial_binding_requirements: resolve exact frame and unit literals
include an outside near-duplicate mesh with empty selection
bind actual edit membership, selection flush and typed history
capture native component order separately from interpolated tags
remaining_before_freeze: capture/checker, independent initial binding and negative controls
coverage_scope: all two-factor assignments plus named focused three-factor products; not the complete Cartesian product or complete numeric/data/capacity domains
